verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a GitHub Actions workflow that deploys tasks on push to main, a CLI for local dev, deploy and self-hosting, and a programmatic management SDK (e.g. `runs.list`) backed by per-environment API keys with scopes, task restrictions and expirations. Together these cover headless and CI-driven automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, explicit docs on non-interactive CLI authentication in CI, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none).
